what: Merck (MSD outside North America) is a large drugmaker whose biggest product is the cancer immunotherapy Keytruda; it also sells vaccines (Gardasil) and animal-health products.
customers: Patients through doctors, insurers, governments and veterinarians.
money: Keytruda (roughly half of sales), Gardasil and other drugs
medicines and vaccines for livestock and pets
moat: Keytruda's broad approvals across many cancers, vaccine manufacturing, and a deep pipeline.
opportunities: Gross margin of 75% with a 34% operating margin
Its subcutaneous version of Keytruda extends the franchise past the injection patent
Analysts see about 21% upside from current levels
watch: Keytruda sales and the uptake of its subcutaneous formulation.
